verdict.rationale: Antigravity supports MCP servers (docs-14, docs-22) which could in principle be used to connect to Jira, Slack, or other workflow tools, and Google Drive links can appear in the sidebar Documents section (docs-32), but there is no evidence of native, named integrations or pre-built connectors for Jira, Slack, or Drive as workflow context sources. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party connectors/integrations for Jira and Slack, documented Drive API integration beyond file-link display, and any hands-on confirmation that these specific tools work via MCP.
